messages:
alex: Quick question 1 I'm relocating from OR (US) to Portugal (PT) permanently, effective 2026-05-01. What happens to my monthly WFH stipend and health benefits?

maria: Congrats on the move! For stipend: default is prorate in the transition month unless you request alignment to the payroll date (1st or 15th). Benefits: you'll stay on US coverage until the benefits termination date; local PT benefits require docs and have a short eligibility gap (~30 days).

payroll-bot: Checklist: submit Homebase Change form, upload local tax ID (NIF) and Portuguese bank (IBAN) 10 business days before cutover to avoid payment delays.

alex: If I want no prorate and full-month stipend on May 1, do I need to change my stipend payment date?

maria: Yes — pick the payroll-aligned date on the form. That triggers a payroll schedule change; we can do it for the May cycle if docs are in by 2026-04-18.

sam: Finance note: we'll run a tax-nexus scan for PT; if any entity concerns appear we'll loop in legal which can add 3-5 business days.

alex: Got it, submitting docs today. Thanks all.
